subject.title: [Feature Request] Telegram inline buttons for pairing approve/deny

question: Should Telegram chat callbacks be allowed to approve or deny pairing/device requests, and which operator scopes must a button press prove for DM pairing versus operator.admin browser/device approval?
rationale: The requested UX moves a pairing approval from explicit CLI or scoped gateway approval into a chat callback, and current source shows the existing Telegram owner command path only carries operator.pairing for device-pair approvals.

options.title: Design typed approval actions
options.body: Define a reusable approval action with request id, action, expiry, single-use semantics, caller identity, and existing scope enforcement before Telegram renders Approve/Deny buttons.

options.title: Limit to DM sender pairing
options.body: Only add buttons for low-scope channel DM pairing and leave operator.admin device/browser approvals on CLI or Control UI until a separate step-up model lands.

options.title: Defer chat-originated approval
options.body: Keep the command-copy workflow until the broader channel-aware device approval and step-up authorization direction is settled.

recommendation.title: Design typed approval actions
recommendation.body: Define a reusable approval action with request id, action, expiry, single-use semantics, caller identity, and existing scope enforcement before Telegram renders Approve/Deny buttons.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the clearest routing candidate from pairing formatter and device-pair notification/auth history.
